notes.craft: Every JW Anderson product page checked states a country of make (mostly Italy, T-shirt Portugal, one knit Ireland, shoes Italy) and composition, but names no factory or mill. The about page is design history only, with no owned making. Country-only disclosure is a 2.

cities: No store of its own in the US · department stores, and its own site

craft_evidence.owned_d: About-us page (founded 2008 by Jonathan Anderson; accessories first; V&A acquisition) names no owned factory, atelier or workshop. No sustainability or making page linked in the footer.
craft_evidence.countries: PDPs (5/5 state origin): Italy 4 (checkered shirt, mohair cardigan, parachute track pants, half-zip jumper), Portugal 1 (script T-shirt). Shopify descriptions additionally say 'Crafted in Italy' for 3 loafers/derbies and 'Made in Ireland' for the Sheep jumper; the origin field on PDPs is a structured line separate from the description, so items without it in the description still show it on the PDP.
